success_semantics: Successful nonzero realloc preserves the first min(old_byte_length,new_byte_length) bytes as a flat prefix, not rows or components. Width changes are permitted by these wrappers and must not be reduced to an unchanged-width-only contract.
Growth adds bytes with unspecified content. No zero/default fill appears for coordinates, connectivity or direct integer arrays. A null old pointer means all new bytes are unspecified.
Shrink discards suffix bytes. A later regrowth cannot claim the old discarded bytes are preserved, even if the allocator happens to reuse the same capacity/address.
Same-length realloc may move storage but preserves all prior bytes. Native pointer stability is not part of portable value equivalence.

Zero-width means a zero-size realloc even with positive count. Exact CRT pointer result/ownership and allocation failure are not covered; this requires a distinct unsupported/qualified outcome, not inferred native-null behavior.
direct_buffers.width_change_example: For old flat values[a,b,c,d] and width2->3 with count2, retain positions0..3 exactly and represent positions4..5 as unspecified. Do not move c,d to positions3,4 based on row meaning.

honest_portable_representation.proposal: Store physical backing bytes or typed backing values together with per-byte (or whole-element when aligned) knownness. Resizing copies both the retained prefix and its knownness; newly grown positions become unknown. Keep length and shape separate from value validity.
honest_portable_representation.safe_backing: The C++ backing may be initialized to a deterministic safe placeholder to avoid undefined reads, but the placeholder is not an observed original value and must never be serialized or compared as known data.
honest_portable_representation.writes: Expose writes through APIs that mark exactly the written bytes/elements known. Current mutable spans cannot track what callers actually write; either introduce a write/commit-range API or explicitly require callers to mark initialized ranges after span writes.
honest_portable_representation.reads: Provide a knownness-aware read/result. A computation that consumes an unknown coordinate or direct integer must propagate unknown or return a documented incomplete-state result; do not silently feed the placeholder into scientific calculations.
honest_portable_representation.serialization_and_comparison: Export extent plus known ranges/validity mask and observed values only for known positions. Compare shapes and retained known prefix exactly; classify grown tails as unspecified rather than equal-to-zero. Runtime samples can be retained as samples but must not become stable expected values.
honest_portable_representation.bit_preservation: Use byte-preserving copies for the prefix, particularly doubles, to avoid replacing a bitwise native realloc guarantee with numeric-only equality. Knownness must follow bytes through any future partial write.
honest_portable_representation.completeness_limit: This represents all valid width-growth cases honestly without inventing native tail contents. It establishes partial semantic compatibility, not deterministic equality for a later computation that reads original allocator-dependent bytes.

recommended_verification_cases: Seed nonzero direct buffers and ordinary descriptor values, change widths up/down and preserve exact flat prefix; verify unknown tails without requiring particular native bytes.
Shrink then regrow, and null-to-positive growth, verifying knownness does not resurrect discarded values.
Equal-product descriptor shape changes update history but retain all values and skipMATAXI initialization.
MATAXI width9 growth and shrink reset all surviving diagonals while preserving off-diagonal prefix; width9 sameproduct does not reset diagonals.
Node count0/negative or element count0/negative is complete wrapper no-op, including post descriptors and allocated arity; use standalone helper scope if invalid metadata cannot be reached normally.
Divergent header/container counts or selected/allocated arity prove getter-based choices; do not seed only fully consistent successful imports.
Post-only descriptor prepopulated through explicit selection remains untouched on bulk refresh.
Unit-only multiplicity refresh still shifts special multiplicity history; no reapplication of node8/state44/direct61 replacement fills.
For unchanged positive direct byte lengths, exact original/candidate numeric comparison is valid; separately exercise growth with partial knownness rather than making this the only supportedcase.
